what_approval_means: Approval means somebody accepted this exact file for replay during a demonstration. It says the file is the one that was accepted and has not changed since. It does not say a service produced what is in it, and it does not by itself say the contents may be published.
what_repository_head_at_review_means: The commit the repository stood at when the file was reviewed. It is not the commit that carries this record, because a manifest cannot hold the identifier of the commit that adds it. The commit that carries the record is the one that changed this file in the history.

history_rewrites.what_it_did: Removed email addresses and the structured contact elements around them from replies, in the current files and in the history. Author names and affiliations were deliberately left in place.
history_rewrites.effect_on_this_manifest: Identifiers recorded before this date name commits from the earlier history and cannot be reached from the current one.
